decisions.question: How does the user pick which source to import from?
options: Stepped wizard (pick source → authenticate/upload → review → confirm)
Unified dropzone that auto-detects file type
Flat source list with per-source CTA buttons
decisions.selected: Stepped wizard (pick source → authenticate/upload → review → confirm)

decisions.question: How should the import flow handle items that already exist in the library?
options: Inline review — surface each duplicate with keep/replace/skip choices
Batch report after the import completes
Silent skip — never overwrite, no prompt
decisions.selected: Inline review — surface each duplicate with keep/replace/skip choices

decisions.question: Where does the import flow live in the app?
options: Dedicated /import page reachable from library + onboarding
Settings tab under Account → Import & Export
Modal flow over the library view
decisions.selected: Dedicated /import page reachable from library + onboarding

decisions.question: How is import progress shown during long-running imports?
options: Inline progress bar with item-count + ETA
Toast that links to a background jobs page
decisions.selected: Inline progress bar with item-count + ETA

decisions.question: How do we obtain auth for sources that require it (Goodreads, Steam, Letterboxd)?
options: OAuth redirect with per-provider client credentials
User pastes a long-lived API token
User uploads an export file only (no live auth at all)
decisions.selected: OAuth redirect with per-provider client credentials

deferred.question: Should we rate-limit per-source independently or have a global token bucket?
